artworks.title: An Old House in the Rue Saint Jean at Caen, Normandy
artworks.medium: graphite and wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed facade of a historic stone building. The windows are decorated with ornate carvings and sculptures, featuring intricate frames with a pointed arch and tracery designs. Below the windows is an awning over a sidewalk, with figures in period clothing engaging in various activities. Another figure is seen sitting in an archway on the left side. The architectural details suggest a Gothic or Renaissance style, with richly adorned stonework and carefully rendered textures indicating attention to detail. The drawing captures an old street scene, suggesting social interaction and daily life in a bygone era.

artworks.title: The Dawn of Creation
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with scratching out
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape at sunset. The viewpoint is from a high vantage, looking out over the rugged terrain as the sun sets in the sky. The horizon is situated slightly above the center, with the sun partially visible, casting a soft glow over the peaks. The painting style features textured brushstrokes emphasizing the rocky landscape. A monochromatic color palette of dark to light shades creates a stark atmosphere. The scene includes jagged rocks in the foreground, leading the eye towards a vast vista of ascending mountains under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Brothers Konrad and Franz Eberhard
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund, Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two men, both shown from the chest up in a side-by-side profile. The man on the left is positioned facing slightly to the right, while the man on the right turns his head towards the viewer, allowing a partial view of his other profile. The man on the left has medium-length, wavy hair that falls below his ears, and wears a cap. His expression appears focused, with furrowed brows. The man on the right has short, straight hair with a side part. His expression is serious and intent. Both men are clad in formal wear; the man on the left is in a dark robe with a high collar, while the man on the right has a white collar and a knotted cloth beneath it. No visible jewelry is present on either. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins and a Waterfall
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a high horizon line, showing distant hills and small buildings. In the foreground, figures are gathered near a stream with rocky banks. A cart pulled by horses travels on a road, and to the left, there are cliffs with trees. The details are finely depicted, with a monochrome color palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Ruined Towers
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. The terrain is rugged, with hills, clay cliffs, trees, and small architectural ruins. A group of figures is seen on a rocky path leading towards a circular structure surrounded by trees in the distance. The etching style employs fine lines for details and textures. The palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background creating depth. The sky has cloud patterns, adding to the sense of depth in the image.

artworks.title: Landscape with Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a village in the distance among rolling hills. Detailed engravings of trees are depicted, showcasing a monochrome palette. Livestock and figures are present in the foreground, adding scale and narrative to the scene.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Flutist
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated vantage point overlooking a wide valley. The horizon is at the upper third of the image with distant mountains. In the middle, a waterfall flows down a rocky slope surrounded by trees. The style features detailed engravings of foliage and rocks with a monochromatic color palette of gray and black. Various plants and rocks are at the forefront, and two figures are visible on a pathway.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Family by a River
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape with a dirt path winding through lush vegetation. Two figures and a child are walking on the path, while another figure is sitting on the ground nearby. The horizon shows trees, a bridge with multiple arches, and distant mountain peaks, all created with intricate engraving in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Young Woman Climbing a Step
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seen from the back, standing on a step with her left arm extended upwards and her right arm raised near her head. She has shoulder-length wavy hair, and is wearing a dress with a fitted bodice and a flowing, layered skirt. The drawing shows folds and pleats in the skirt, and the woman appears to not be wearing jewelry. The background is plain textured paper.

artworks.title: Fashionable Young Woman Stepping Forward
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woman standing with her hands pulling at her skirt. She has a softly drawn face with closed eyes and neutral expression. Her hair is styled in a bun with a headdress. She wears a long dress with a fitted bodice and a full skirt. The background is a plain, light bluish-grey surface.

artworks.title: Young Woman's Hands and Beribboned Hat
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on buff laid papaer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an arm and hands with an adjacent still-life element. The drawing depicts a bent arm resting on fabric or drapery with two hands, one resting over the other. The outlines and shading are done using pencil. Beside the arm on the lower portion of the page, there is a sketch of an abstract or amorphous still-life object. The background is plain, allowing the sketch to be the main focal point. The style suggests it is a preliminary study or practice sketch, showcasing careful observation of anatomy.

artworks.title: Standing Woman Leaning on Her Elbow
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woman from head to knee-level. She is standing or leaning against an unseen surface, with her torso turned slightly to her left. Her facial features are delicately sketched, highlighting the outline of her nose, eyebrows, and swept back bun hairstyle. Her hair is neatly styled away from her face. She wears a long, flowing garment that drapes down to the bottom of the drawing, resembling a gown-like dress with soft, fluid lines capturing the fabric folds. Her hands are in front of her, with one gently grasping the other. The background is plain, focusing attention on the figure, with the paper texture providing a subtle backdrop for the drawing.

artworks.title: La Blanchisseuse
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a woman doing laundry. There is a house with a thatched roof, a large tree, and various natural elements like wood and foliage. The intricate etching technique captures textures. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting fine lines and cross-hatching. The scene includes a stony path, a wooden structure, water pools, trees, and bushes, creating a rustic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Unweit Visp in Wallis / Thomas Platters Geburts Ort
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a mountain village scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The foreground shows two wooden buildings, figures, and a flock of sheep. In the background, there are rugged mountain slopes, evergreen trees, and a waterfall. The artwork uses a sepia tone with detailed linework, giving it a classic and serene appearance.

artworks.title: Les Laveuses (The Laundresses)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul S. Morgan in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point of a rustic setting. In the foreground, figures are washing near a stream with basins and laundry items. A thatched-roof cottage is nestled against a low hill, partially obscured by trees. The cottage leads to a wooden structure. Trees populate the scene, concealing the horizon. They vary in size and shape with winding branches and detailed foliage blending into the sky. Stylized clouds fill the sky. The image is in a monochromatic scheme of brown tones. Brushstrokes are intricate, highlighting textures and details.

artworks.title: Untitled (Courtyard, New Orleans)
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 295 x 192 mm
Sheet: 324 x 210 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an enclosed courtyard from a ground-level perspective. In the foreground, there is a sculptural fountain with a cherubic figure in a circular basin. Surrounding the courtyard are tall, narrow buildings with balconies, various window styles, a rooftop with dormer windows, and a chimney. In the upper right corner, there are slender tree branches. The intricate details and textures are shown through precise linework using black ink on a creamy background.

artworks.title: Rainy Night, Chinatown
artworks.dimensions:
image: 256 x 280 mm
sheet:  330 x 353 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow street surrounded by tall buildings. At the end of the street is a building with a spire. The rooftops and the spire create an implied horizon against a softly textured sky. The scene is rendered in a style resembling watercolor or ink wash, with a monochrome color palette of black, white, and various shades of gray. Sparse figures can be seen on the street.

artworks.title: Negro Huts at Wilmington
artworks.dimensions:
image:  95 x 146 mm
sheet:  219 x 302 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene, possibly a rural village or farmstead. The horizon is low and merges with the ground in light shading. Thatched, gabled roofs of houses are prominent on the right side. The style of the image features fine etching lines, giving texture to the roofs and terrain. Near us on the ground, a group of figures, possibly villagers, are engaged in activities. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and dark tones. The scene extends into the background with a faded structure and a tree.

artworks.title: Grave-yard Dirt
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 355 x 280 mm
Sheet: 434 x 354 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person emerging from a body of water. The individual is shown in a side profile, with their head tilted upwards and eyes gazing skyward. The facial features are clearly defined, with a prominent jawline and short, textured hair. Their clothing resembles a wet, sleeveless top. Surrounding the person is a natural environment featuring trees and birds perched on a branch. The birds have wide eyes and are focused on the individual below. The scene is in monochrome, with minimal background details, emphasizing the human figure and birds in the foreground.

artworks.dimensions:
image: 425 x 675 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  610 x 790 mm
plate:   500 x 740 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a field scene with workers in an agricultural setting. The landscape is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing the workers and land. The field is populated with women performing various tasks with baskets and bags. The style is similar to a monochromatic etching with fine lines and a blended texture. The color scheme consists primarily of sepia tones, creating a warm and vintage look. The sky has a light texture with brushstrokes, indicating a serene day with birds flying.

artworks.title: Untitled (Farmer's Daughter)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 522 x 346 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  645 x 492 mm

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman standing in an outdoor rural setting. She is in a relaxed position with her left hand on her hip and her right hand holding a wooden bucket. She wears a simple dress with puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice under a long apron that extends to her feet, in addition to a wide-brimmed hat. Her facial features are softly detailed, with a gentle expression, and her hair is tucked under her hat. The background features a stone wall, trees, a grassy field scattered with wildflowers, and a glimpse of a windmill structure.

artworks.title: In Low Tide
artworks.dimensions:
image: 341 x 282 mm
sheet:  440 x 378 mm
plate:   370 x 314 mm

artworks.description: The image shows a nautical scene with calm waters and a high horizon with a distant strip of land and buildings. A large sailing ship is positioned slightly right of center, with smaller vessels and buildings to the left. The style is detailed with fine lines and shading, giving a monochromatic, sepia-toned appearance. The water reflects the ships and the sky above.

artworks.description: This image depicts two women by a large window. The woman on the left is standing, holding a rose near her face, while the woman on the right is seated, holding a book in her lap. The background shows a pastoral scene outside the window. The room has wooden accents.
